she is caught mid-motion leaning a fraction toward the moving steel, weight shifted onto her front boot, chin tilted, shoulders tensed and breath held as she tries to catch her own reflection, one hand half-lifted toward her face and abandoned mid-gesture, the beginning of a laugh breaking through her deadpan raised-eyebrow expression; immediately behind her an express train rips past in a hard motion-blurred smear of stainless steel, its door panels and lit windows strobing bright bars of light across her, her reflection smeared and unreadable in the flying metal; the platform behind and beside her shows white subway tile columns with black route bands, riveted I-beam columns painted institutional green, gum-stained concrete floor and a bright yellow tactile edge stripe, a scrap of litter and dust lifting in the tunnel wind that also lifts her hair sideways, the dark tunnel mouth swallowing depth at frame left; harsh overhead fluorescent and LED platform banks throw clean top-light with crisp directional shadows under the brow and jaw, punchy near-flash contrast on her face, sodium-yellow warmth bleeding from the far end of the platform, cool white tile and steel grey filling the frame with a single coral accent on her lips;
